tagline: Fishing for over 60 years off the Alabama Gulf Coast

hours.notes: Red Snapper trips available 7 days a week during season. Departure times vary and custom trips available.

about.description: Family-owned and operated charter business in Orange Beach, Alabama with over 60 years of fishing experience. Offers family-friendly half-day, full-day, and overnight charter trips with custom options available. Built and maintained private reefs for over 50 years.
about.elevator_pitch: Gulf Rebel Charters is a family-owned offshore fishing charter company in Orange Beach, Alabama offering Red Snapper, Tuna, Wahoo, and specialty fishing trips with over 60 years of experience.
about.vibe: Professional, family-friendly, experienced, accommodating to all skill levels
about.capacity: 6+ persons per boat depending on vessel
about.reservations: Recommended - trips book up fast, especially Red Snapper season
about.insider_tip: Red Snapper trips book up very quickly. Red Snapper season typically runs June 1st through late September. Private reefs maintained for 50+ years make finding fish reliable.

features: Big Green Egg grill on board
